encounter_distance_au.help: Distance scale that defines early interaction geometry in the simplified model.

correction_window_years.help: Effective horizon during which early interventions still provide leverage.

initial_delta_v_mps.help: Initial correction authority available to the concept trajectory.

uncertainty_growth_per_year.help: Annualized growth of compounded navigation uncertainty in reduced-order form.

dust_flux_scale.help: Dimensionless scale for mm-tail dust exposure stress in the simplified environment.

shield_geometry_factor.help: Geometric attenuation factor for lethal-hit rate under nominal orientation assumptions.

narrative_leverage_multiplier.help: Sensitivity-only scale to stress-test interpretation elasticity.
narrative_leverage_multiplier.warning: Non-physical knobs break realism; use for sensitivity exploration only.

irreversibility_override.help: Sensitivity-only additive override to probe edge-case irreversibility assumptions.
irreversibility_override.warning: Non-physical knobs break realism; use for sensitivity exploration only.

step_years.help: Fixed simulation step used for deterministic time integration.

horizon_years.help: Total simulated horizon for trend and finite-window estimates.
